data.purpose: Monospaced code, paths, and rule ASTs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with muted violet accent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8f7fe8; color: #14102a; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Studio Shell Navigation Tab
components.description: Active tab in the Studio 54px header bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #72728a; padding: 0 12px; height: 54px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tab-active { color: #fbfbfe; border-bottom-color: #fbfbfe; }

components.name: Rule Verdict Chip (Denied)
components.css: .ds-chip-denied { background: #ededee; color: #0c0c0d; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Pyric's visual identity is a minimalist, zero-noise dark interface where whitespace and strict vertical rhythm carry structure without heavy boxes or aggressive fills. Calm surface steps with low contrast between them keep the interface focused on data, rules, and code execution.

rules.name: The Single Spotlight Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is restricted to <=10% of any view.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Drop-shadows are omitted in favor of clear surface step contrast and 1px hairline borders.

rules.name: The Top-Heavy Gap Rule
rules.body: The margin-block-start above any heading always dwarfs the gap below the preceding block.

dos: Do use strict vertical rhythm tokens (--rhythm-para, --rhythm-group, --rhythm-section).
Do keep primary violet accent usage under 10% of any view surface.
Do use var(--font-mono) for all code, paths, and security rule expressions.
donts: Don't use heavy drop shadows or gradient backgrounds.
Don't introduce ad-hoc hex values; reference semantic CSS variables.
Don't create blue-tinted dark backgrounds; preserve neutral charcoal tones.
